sulk.definition:
n. a mood or display of sullen aloofness or withdrawal
v. be in a huff and display one's displeasure
sulk.translation:
n. 闹情绪, 闷闷不乐
vi. 不高兴, 闷闷不乐, 不悦, 生气, 愠怒

sulked.definition: v be in a huff and display one's displeasure
sulked.translation: v. 生闷气, 愠怒( sulk的过去式和过去分词 )

sulkies.translation: n. 愠怒的( sulky的名词复数 ); 绷着脸的; 生闷气的; 不搭理人的

sulkily.translation: adv. 乖戾地, 悻悻然, 闷闷不乐地

sulkiness.definition:
n. a feeling of sulky resentment
n. a sullen moody resentful disposition
sulkiness.translation: n. 不高兴, 闷闷不乐的样子

sulking.definition: v be in a huff and display one's displeasure
sulking.translation: v. 生闷气, 愠怒( sulk的现在分词 )

sulkowitch reagent.translation: [医] 萨耳科维奇氏试剂(检尿钙)

sulkowitch's reagent.translation: [医] 萨耳科维奇氏试验(检尿钙)

sulkowitch's test.translation: [医] 萨耳科维奇氏试验(检尿钙)

sulks.definition:
n. pl. The condition of being sulky; a sulky mood or humor; as,
   to be in the sulks.
sulks.translation:
n. 生闷气, 愠怒; 生闷气, 愠怒( sulk的名词复数 )
v. 生闷气, 愠怒( sulk的第三人称单数 )

sulky.definition: n. a light two-wheeled vehicle for one person; drawn by one horse
sulky.translation: a. 生气的, 阴沉的
